entries.42786103f6104f90: At consolidated subsidiary LIKE Staffing Co., Ltd., it provides staffing dispatch services, outsourcing services that collectively contract out the operation and management of shops and sales corners and the operation of logistics warehouses, and placement services. Its main business areas are the mobile, logistics and manufacturing, and childcare and nursing care industries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥21,982 million.
entries.ba7fec2d6f5e3348: At consolidated subsidiary LIKE Kids Co., Ltd., it provides public childcare services, including the directly operated certified nursery “Nijiiro Hoikuen,” public nurseries operated under designated management, and after-school clubs, as well as entrusted childcare services that take on the operation of childcare facilities established by hospitals, companies, and universities. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥35,814 million.
entries.d2a0823f2334db65: This business is outside the reportable segments and handles group procurement of goods and external sales services, among others. External revenue for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥136 million.
entries.d453e2cb211b9be9: The company is a holding company. Within its group of the company and 8 subsidiaries, it conducts the childcare support service business, the general staffing service business, and the nursing care-related service business (as of May 31, 2026).
entries.d4b8f3e747c2af33: A holding company that, through subsidiaries, operates licensed nursery schools and similar facilities, provides staffing and recruitment services, and operates nursing care facilities.
